# Text engine test data

- `DroidSans*.ttf`: Droid Sans, Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE-DroidSans.txt`).
- `SivTest-*.ttf`: blocky test fonts for the font family tests (D13),
  generated by `make_test_fonts.py` (part of siv, MIT; needs fontTools):
  static Regular, Bold, and Italic faces of family "SivTest", and a
  variable font "SivTest VF" with wght, wdth, opsz, and slnt axes whose
  glyph advances follow the axes so tests can measure them.
